cohort: Infants born from June 1, 2011, to April 30, 2017
finding: This study found that racial differences in the rates of atopic dermatitis (AD) arise early in life, with Black infants having the highest prevalence and the diagnosis being associated with race rather than delivery mode, insurance type, and gestational age.
mod_finding: While delivery mode was significantly associated with race, the study found that it was not associated with the development of atopic dermatitis in infants.
